MPC rose 0.44% today as the refining sector continued to benefit from strong operational conditions. U.S. refineries are running at 95.2% capacity with oil inventories elevated at 694 million barrels, supporting steady margins for processors like Marathon. The stock has climbed $42 (over 11%) in just the past week, reflecting a sharp reversal from its two-week dip of -6.76%.

The broader context here is mixed for refiners going forward. While heating oil prices have spiked 59% from last winter—which typically boosts demand for refined products—recent news about rising shipping costs and cautious retail inventory strategies suggest softer overall fuel demand ahead. Additionally, the IEA reported that Russian crude production has rebounded, pushing global oil markets back into surplus, which could pressure refining margins over time even if near-term conditions remain supportive.
